drawio.title: draw.io / diagrams.net Shape Libraries
drawio.subtitle: Brand and dev-tool icons, ready to drop into your diagrams.
drawio.step1: Open draw.io (or diagrams.net) with a diagram you're working on.
drawio.step2: At the bottom of the left-hand Shapes panel, click the grid icon labeled "More Shapes".
drawio.step3: In the dialog that opens, scroll down and choose "Open Library from Device...".
drawio.step4: Pick the downloaded .xml file for the category you want.
drawio.step5: The icons appear as a new panel in the left sidebar, ready to drag onto the canvas.
drawio.cardBlurb: {{label}} brand and tool logos, ready to drag onto your diagram.

excalidraw.title: Excalidraw Shape Libraries
excalidraw.intro: Downloadable custom Excalidraw libraries of brand and developer tool icons, grouped by category, for architecture and product diagrams.
excalidraw.step1: Open Excalidraw and expand the shape library panel on the right side of the toolbar.
excalidraw.step2: Click the "..." menu at the top of the library panel and choose "Open".
excalidraw.step4: The icons are added to your personal library, ready to drag onto the canvas.
excalidraw.librariesNote: Each file is a self-contained .excalidrawlib you can load independently.
